body.name: four-node profile-collision path
body.construction: For \(d=4\), \(r=2\), and \(E=2\), take \(a=(1,1,2,1)^{\mathsf T}\), \(b=(0,1,1,2)^{\mathsf T}\), \(\Sigma_0=I_4\), \(\Delta_1=aa^{\mathsf T}+bb^{\mathsf T}\), and \(\Delta_2(\gamma)=2aa^{\mathsf T}+(2+\gamma)bb^{\mathsf T}\).  Set \(\Sigma_e=\Sigma_0+\Delta_e\), \(\theta_\gamma=(\Sigma_0,\Sigma_1,\Sigma_2)\), and \(\bar Q=\Delta_1+\Delta_2=3aa^{\mathsf T}+(3+\gamma)bb^{\mathsf T}\).
